Name: Navi Fairy Trinket
Author: olioleander
Description:
When I found the fairy trinket it immediately reminded me of Navi from The Legend of Zelda, so I modded it in :)

To install, make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher, and then unzip the .zip into your Mods folder.

This mod will only work for 1.6 as it uses new content.

Downloads.Description: Updated to cover extra sprites from 1.6.6
